svg.title: EMG BCI: every reach the user saw, by feedback lag and in position control
svg.desc: Displayed cursor position against time from the go cue for all 19 reaches in each run, with the target folded to the top so 6 means on target. 0 ms: 10 of 19 reaches succeeded; ≈125 ms: 16 of 19 reaches succeeded; ≈360 ms: 2 of 19 reaches succeeded; ≈590 ms: 4 of 19 reaches succeeded; position control: 0 of 19 reaches succeeded. At zero and about 125 ms of added lag most reaches settle in the target band; from about 360 ms the cursor overshoots and oscillates, and in position control every reach reaches the target but none holds it.
svg.text: target is always up. Time runs
from the go cue to the trial's end,
up to 5 s to reach + 0.5 s hold.
Each condition is one run of 19 scored reaches, recorded on 3 March 2026 with me as the user.
